Guide.overview:
Sample data.

This baseline covers the sign-in and app consent settings we expect in every tenant.

**Before you start**

- Check that no line-of-business app depends on users registering their own applications.
- Decide who approves app consent requests, because users can no longer consent on their own.

**How to roll it out**

1. Assign the baseline to one tenant and leave everything on report only.
2. Review the deviations with the client.
3. Turn on remediation per standard once the client agrees.

stages.name: Baseline
stages.guide:
Sample data.

All six standards can go out together. The only one users notice is app consent: they get an approval request instead of a consent prompt.

Allow a week of report only before you turn on remediation.

communications.title: Announcement to the client contact
communications.body:
Hi,

Next week we are tightening the sign-in settings of your Microsoft 365 environment. Passwords no longer expire, accounts lock after repeated failed sign-ins, and staff can register a security key.

Nothing changes in how your staff work day to day. Let us know if you have questions.

communications.title: Notice to staff about app approval
communications.body: From Monday you may see a message asking for approval when you connect a new app to your work account. Send the request and we will review it, usually within one working day.

Baseline.description: Sample data. Sign-in and app consent settings every tenant should have. Everything is report only.
